title: WaterColor "Fun Times" 1660 County Hwy 30-A Unit 102
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 6 amenity access bands.**- Located beachside of 30A, Beach District in Town Center- Just steps from the beach, restaurants, and shopping- Smart Tvs In All Rooms- Washer/Dryer- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Fun Times is located steps away from the Emerald Coast's famous white beaches and the WaterColor Beach Club, Seaside, and great shopping. This Beach District condo makes vacationing a breeze for couples or small families. With 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 2 bed bunk room/utility room, and a queen sleeper sofa, it can sleep 6 guests comfortably. Entertain the family in the fully-equipped kitchen, which features premium stainless steel appliances, or relax in the living area while watching your favorite movie on the Smart TV. There is combined seating for 10 guests at the breakfast bar and dining table to gather for a meal. The living area also features a queen sleeper sofa. Natural light shines through the living area which also open up to the covered deck, which provides a scenic view overlooking the quiet neighborhood with outdoor seating. The laundry room also features an additional 2 bunks and a full-size washer and dryer. The primary bedroom on the first floor provides a king bed with plush white bedding, a flat-screen TV, private access to the screened-in patio, and an ensuite with marble tile in both the shower and tub. The guest bedroom is upstairs and features a plush queen bed and a full, private bathroom. After a day of lounging at the beach, you can explore on foot or with the 2 complimentary bikes. WaterColor offers a variety of attractions, including shops, restaurants, nature trails, and opportunities to kayak or paddleboard on Western Lake. Additionally, guests can enjoy access to 5 tennis courts and 5 swimming pools. For even more options, adjacent Seaside boasts a vast array of boutiques and restaurants. Don't miss your chance to stay in WaterColor's Beach District—book this unit today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathrooms with Shower- Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa- Additional Bunk Beds share a space with the Laundry RoomWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickle ball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preserves*Watercolor Community HOA prohibits the rental of Low-Speed Vehicles for guests staying in the Town Center.
